inherits.unchanged: geometry, source model, contrast construction, reconstruction class, arms, estimators, feature extraction, normalisation denominators, aggregate, endpoints, materiality, tolerances and family agreement are inherited verbatim from the validation freeze. This freeze changes the truths and nothing else

design.regime_reading: each held-out truth is evaluated under all three background regimes, so the regime comparison is paired on the same truth. The ruling says '16 fresh truths per family, 6 families, 3 background regimes', which reads as 96 truths seen three ways rather than 288 separate draws. Recording the reading because the other one is available and would change the count
design.noiseless_control_role: reported alongside the noisy draws and gated by HMT1M_G15. It is not part of the endpoint statistic: an endpoint averaged over a draw that has no noise would report a number no instrument can produce
design.estimator_scope_note: item 12. NONNEGATIVE_CONSTRAINED was declared in the validation freeze as a control and never implemented, so it has no selected hyperparameter. Selecting one now is the retuning item 8 of ruling 015 forbids, so it is withdrawn as unselected rather than run. ML was never authorized. HMT1M_G19 checks that the estimators actually run are exactly the authorized set and that no withdrawn or unauthorized one appears

regime_roles.estimated_from_data: CLAIM_BEARING. The reported result is the one obtained here
regime_roles.rule: a result that exists only under a confirmatory regime is reported as background-assisted and does not pass

sealed_hyperparameters.provenance: selected on the validation selection split by the corrected scorer, canonical run HMT1_20260827T224512Z_2ba66f02
sealed_hyperparameters.all_interior: no selected value sits at either end of its grid, which is what HMT1_G12 checked and passed in the validation
sealed_hyperparameters.rule: used verbatim. The sealed main performs no selection sweep at all -- there is no code path in the main runner that evaluates a second hyperparameter

prohibited_in_the_sealed_main: hyperparameter selection or retuning of any kind
changing an estimator or adding one
changing the feature list scored for any family
changing any tolerance, epsilon, quantile or materiality bar
excluding a family, a truth, an arm or a regime after seeing it
adding a source family or an off-manifold control to the endpoint
re-running with a different seed and reporting the better run

bootstrap.intervals: one for the per-truth median and one for the cell-balanced mean, each named where reported

stable_feature_interval.statistic: L_stable_features(epsilon, q) = sup{T >= 0 : Pr[sup_{0 <= a <= T} E_features(a) <= epsilon] >= q}, supremum inside the probability, over truth and noise jointly
stable_feature_interval.requirement: strictly positive for the resolved arm, and greater than the direct arm's

primary.event_time_error: reported for flare_birth_motion_decay in M, with its own interval
primary.trajectory_error: angular and radial error reported separately in radians and M, not only as the normalised aggregate

secondary.rendered_frame_error: relative error of the rendered dj frame
secondary.rule: secondary. Neither may carry the primary claim, and a perceptually convincing frame is not evidence that the trajectory was measured

endpoints.note: inherited verbatim. Reproduced here so the sealed document is self-contained and a later edit to the validation freeze cannot silently move this endpoint

material_benefit_under_both_classical_es.note: the same numeric standard R1L used, so the two studies are comparable

family_agreement.declared_rule: at least three quarters of the declared families, rounded up
family_agreement.ambiguity_recorded: the authorizing ruling says 'at least 3/4 families'. Earlier rulings used 'three of the four' when there were exactly four families; here there are six. The fraction reading is taken as primary because it preserves the stringency of the earlier rule, and the literal count reading (3 of 6) is also reported so the reviewer can see both and overturn this choice

survives_estimated_background.rule: a result that exists only under the oracle background is reported as background-assisted and does not pass

dispositions.HMT1_MAIN_FEATURE_RECOVERY_PASS: every criterion met in the claim-bearing regime
dispositions.HMT1_MAIN_BACKGROUND_ASSISTED_ONLY: criteria met only under a confirmatory regime
dispositions.HMT1_MAIN_MATERIAL_ERROR_REDUCTION_NO_ST: material feature-error reduction with no positive stable feature interval
dispositions.HMT1_MAIN_NO_MATERIAL_EFFECT: banks sound, materiality not met. A reportable result
dispositions.HMT1_MAIN_SOURCE_BANK_FAILURE: a held-out bank could not be built within the contrast-model tolerances
dispositions.HMT1_MAIN_IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT: a gate failed, a limit was exceeded, a commitment did not reproduce, or a committed bank hash did not match

two_stage_execution.rule: item 9. All final source and feature hashes are committed before any operator is applied to a held-out truth

stage_a.does: draws the held-out truths, extracts their features, and writes per-truth sha256 of the emissivity field and of the extracted feature history

stage_b.does: rebuilds the same bank, verifies every hash against the committed file, and only then applies the operator

seeds.freshness: different values from the validation seeds, and the seed commitment payload carries split='sealed_main_heldout', a string no validation commitment used. Disjointness is therefore by construction and is checked as well

gate_stages.rule: every source-side gate is decided before an operator is imported, and stage B refuses to import one unless all of them passed

retired_gate.HMT1M_G10b_truth_extraction_recovers_gen: FAIL / RETIRED_RAW_TRAJECTORY_PROXY_INVALID_FOR_WINDOWED_FEATURE. Preserved in the correction record, not re-run

gate_notes.HMT1M_G3_disjoint_from_validation_and_re: held-out seeds that also appear in the validation bank or in any bank this freeze has retired. Must be zero, so a retired bank cannot be redrawn under a new name
gate_notes.HMT1M_G10c_truth_extraction_matches_inde: one evaluation-grid cell, the same frozen threshold the retired G10b carried. The reference windows the analytic field first and then finds its maxima, which is the question the extractor answers; the retired proxy compared against the instantaneous generative centre, which a feature moving inside the window does not occupy. Validated on 396 truths before this freeze: the complete validation bank, three scratch banks and the analytic canaries in the test suite
gate_notes.HMT1M_G18_stage_a_source_gates_passed: stage B emits this after confirming stage A's gate file shows no failure. It is a record of the check, not the check itself: the check happens before the operator imports
gate_notes.HMT1M_G19_estimator_scope: symmetric difference between the estimators actually run and the authorized set, plus any withdrawn estimator that ran. Must be zero
gate_notes.HMT1M_G20_endpoint_lineage_firewall: blocked tables that reached disk anyway. Must be zero. The firewall screens column lineage rather than filenames, because the table that leaked last time was named for a control and carried per-arm medians of the old-band feature error

numerical_environment.assertion: every BLAS pool must report one thread, interrogated after import

scope.authorized: the HMT-1 sealed held-out main, and nothing else
